intro: Jordanian culture centres on Bedouin hospitality, coffee and food shared from a big platter.

chapters.title: Hospitality
text: Guests are offered bitter Arabic coffee with cardamom. The red-and-white checked keffiyeh is a national symbol.

chapters.title: Food
text: Mansaf, lamb cooked in fermented dried yoghurt and served on rice, is the national dish, eaten from a shared tray. Falafel, hummus and knafeh are everyday favourites.

keyTerms.meaning: Jordan's national dish of lamb, yoghurt and rice.
